description.zh: 任务成员列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the member list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的任务成员数量，默认为20。
description.en: The number of members per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
统计类型，取值如下：
- ITEM：按照单条审核记录。
- OPERATORCELL：按照操作单元，一个ITEM可能会包含多个操作单元。
description.en:
The statistics type. Valid values:
- ITEM: Statistics are collected based on individual review records.
- OPERATORCELL: Statistics are collected based on operation units. A single ITEM may contain multiple operation units.

description.zh: 任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见[ListTasks](~~454662~~)。
description.en: The job ID. For information about how to obtain a job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).
